title: The old schoolhouse hall at Touro and Dolphin; halls burned and rebuilt
summary: A former schoolhouse with dancing downstairs burned twice and was rebuilt; Foster first played the Mandeville and Rampart hall with Chris Kelly, and a white hall is mentioned.
